{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_count}")

# Remove QA orders
real_completed = completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute the mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
